items.d: The Ponts Couverts are three bridges dominated by four towers from the 12th and 14th centuries. The bridges got their name from their roofs, which they lost in the 18th century. The towers are the remains of the ancient ramparts.
The bathing complex by the lake has a large outdoor pool and an indoor pool.

A sandy beach with a lifeguard located by a quiet, charming lake. Good escape from usual noise of such lakes. Beware as it gets deep relatively fast, no car access, park your car by Greiser road (about 1 km walk).
The programme is advertised outside on a board outside, usually they have a few plays a week. Tickets are sold from a counter on the ground floor, under the stairs.
An almost 250 m long pedestrian suspension bridge built in 16th century across one of the Mochu/Phochu rivers. It's very beautiful and serene, very good to sit and just watch the flow of the river.
A contemporary art museum.
A large water park near Tagarades Hill. Free bus service starting at the city centre.
Ridiculously over sized and out of place, the palace is one of the best examples of the former dictator's hubris. Situated on a hill overlooking the archaeological site, it provides excellent views.
A very pretty (albeit small) botanical garden.
A park with 23 waterslides, a 350-m wave river, a wave pool, a range of other pools, and a disco. Food is overpriced and they search you to keep it that way.
It is a space where you can see the process of mail change and various stamps of the world.
Contemporary art centre and exhibition with coffee shop inside. The name can be interpreted as "she/him, you, and me", or conversation in Bahasa Indonesia.
The third oldest fortification on Ghanaian Coast, built by Portuguese in 1526 to deter British interference which later became ceded to the Dutch and then the British.
The manor is in the village of the same name, directly on the road. It has a rich history. Since the 13th century there was a fortress, which was destroyed in the Livonian War.
That Byin Nyu Temple was built in the mid-12th century during the reign of King Alaungsithu. Adjacent to Ananda Temple, it is the tallest structure in Bagan.
This Roman Catholic church is opposite the main building of the University of Munich (LMU Munich). It's in Romanesque style, and features the second-largest altar fresco in the world.

Mount Roraima is at a height of 2810 m the tallest mountain in Guyana and marks the tri-border between Guyana, Brazil and Venezuela. It can reportedly be seen from Lethem, despite being over 200 km away as the crow flies.
Next to the pleasant river bank.

n.en: Old Market and Tranquil Colonial Center

items.d: An interesting symbol of the division of the population in Kosovo. This bridge was a dividing line between Serbs and Albanians in Mitrovica.

This neo-Gothic style church is named after the vision of the Virgin Mary seen near the appropriately named waterfalls and is therefore a place of pilgrimage for those who come to thank the Virgin for many miracles and to ask for…

n.en: Church of the Virgin of the Holy Water

items.d: This church was built in 690, upon two bastions of the Roman fortress. Its nave is suspended over a passageway. Its wooden roof is supposedly shaped like Noah's ark.
For poet Imadaddin Nasimi of the 14th century.

Sharjah's heyday was in the 1990s when it held many ODI tournaments. Although the games held at the ground were never implicated, the match fixing scandals at the turn of the millennium tarnished Sharjah and its use started to…

The Hall is the earliest medieval structure to be seen within the walls of the city. It was built by the de Burgo family in the 13th century and was the main municipal building, acting as town hall, court house and tax collection…
The venerable New Guinea Club, built in 1937, is now a museum about the history of Rabaul. Lots of photos. Very hot.
Wedged in a mountain crevice sits the Kjerag Boulder, suspended nearly 1,000m above sea level

The Osaka Tournament of Japan's national sport, sumo wrestling, is usually held mid-March annually at Osaka Prefectural Gymnasium. Check for schedules and ticket availabilities at the official Nihon Sumo Kyokai homepage.
There are Christians and Armenians in this region too so the Church of St. Ith Llaha is worth checking out.
Protestant Church which is more than 100 years old.
Privately run museum where the owners, both watchmakers, give you a very interesting personal tour. Do come an hour before closing time to be able to have the full tour and explanations.
A double cascade waterfall amidst lush jungle landscape. Ideal for swimming, hiking and picnics. A refreshing break from the heat and temple tours.
Triumphal arch built by the Italians in 1936.
Extensive collection of American Indian art and artifacts. It is a subsidiary of the Autry Museum and undergoing major renovations.

This village has several interesting sites: Parish Church of San Antonio Abal, a 13th-century church listed as a monument under historic-artistic; Castillo de Ubal, an old fortress built of rocks that surround the area with…
Historic church.
This beach has beautiful fine-grained sand, and it is very shallow. There are many cafes and places to eat ice cream.

A nature preserve just south of Esteli. On the way up, you can stop in Estanzuela and see a waterfall. The water is very cold. But worth the trip. Buses leave everyday except Wednesdays from Cotran Sur at 06:30 and 13:30.
Board rental and surf lessons

PADI Diving courses from beginner to professional. Especially for SPANISH Divers .Diving in small groups with experienced divemasters in a fun environment. More 10 years experience on Malapascua and Divemasters.
The Arc de Triomphe exudes grandeur and offers a central view of the city.
